name: TOB Seller Account
description: One row per Sunday School Student who has applied to sell their own products on edenza.org (WCFM Marketplace). Starts as a plain 'I want to sell' application (Pending Approval); an admin who approves it must first create a real WCFM vendor account + a personal WooCommerce REST API key for this student in edenza.org's WP-Admin (a manual, external step — see marketplace/engine.py's module docstring), then pastes that key/secret in here to activate the row. The stored key is used server-side only, so every product this student creates is correctly attributed to their own WCFM vendor store via WooCommerce's own post_author mechanism — the key is never sent to the Flutter app.

fields.label: Store Name
fields.description: What the student wants their edenza.org storefront called — passed on to whoever sets up their WCFM vendor account.

fields.label: WCFM Vendor Reference
fields.description: Optional admin-facing reference only (e.g. the WP user id or store slug) — never used programmatically.

fields.label: WooCommerce Consumer Key
fields.description: This student's own WooCommerce REST API key (ck_...), created against their WCFM vendor WordPress user. Stored encrypted; read only via frappe.utils.password.get_decrypted_password() from marketplace/engine.py, never returned by any whitelisted method.

fields.label: WooCommerce Consumer Secret
fields.description: Paired with Consumer Key above (cs_...). Stored encrypted.
